    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    for r in range(h - 1):

                corners = [
                    (r - 1, c - 1, -1, -1),
                    (r - 1, c + 2, -1, 1),
                    (r + 2, c - 1, 1, -1),
                    (r + 2, c + 2, 1, 1),
                ]

                recolored = [colors[2], colors[0], colors[3], colors[1]]
                for (rr, cc, dr, dc), color in zip(corners, recolored):

    return out
